# Factory Functions

Constructs child documents from the configured template and frozen creation intent. Keys must be nonempty text without slash or tilde. An occupied collection destination is a duplicate only for the same intent; a different intent fails with `DOCUMENT_KEY_CONFLICT`.

Construction uses explicit participant mapping or the declared child-party configuration, allows only approved input fields and typed value slots, and prevents edits to reserved runtime and identity fields. Templates and nested identity children must be uninitialized. The child receives a deterministic instance key derived from host origin, clause and item key. Only explicitly supported participant channels may be inherited.

Source configuration verifies initialized sources, declared source matching and mapping consistency; it also installs document-access operations. `create` appends the constructed child and a `Document Started` event. These local effects do not confirm later initialization, external access delivery or commercial activation.
